description: Submit a product to the directory on behalf of the connected user. The listing enters the same pending review queue as a web submission; the returned URL is where the submitter finishes and tracks it. Submitting a URL that already exists updates that listing's submitter details instead of creating a duplicate. Requires an authenticated connection: call this tool to get the sign-in instructions.
name: submit_listing
title: Submit a listing (sign-in required)
